theory: Keep the teaching within the supplied linear, quadratic and exponential relationships; hyperbola, circle, translated-circle and cubic instruction is unsupported here. State the necessary restrictions: a quadratic requires a nonzero quadratic coefficient, and a real exponential base requires $a>0$ and $a\ne1$; $a^{x}$ increases for $a>1$ and decreases for $0<a<1$, with the directions reversed for $a^{-x}$. The highest-power-of-$x$ procedure must also accommodate the booklet's vertical line $x=-3$ (Core Q1(g), line 82).

summary: Restricted theory to linear, quadratic and exponential relationships, added the coefficient/base restrictions and correct exponential directions, included vertical lines in the procedure, and corrected the exponential teaching figure to match its stated form. Removed unsupported recognition and equation-generation items, repaired only part (d) of the first Mastery item, replaced the disagreement and circle-graph quiz tasks with cited booklet types, and preserved all other items exactly while retaining the required tier and quiz minimums.
reviewSummary: All 17 final items have correct answers and supported booklet question types, and every quiz has exactly one correct option with appropriate distractor explanations. The theory is usable, all 11 removals are justified, and the required tier and quiz minimums are satisfied.
